fusions.name: Drilled Stroke
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 40% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives a charge back.

fusions.name: Object Lesson
fusions.desc: Sweeps a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 26 damage to every enemy in it. When it hits, you and your allies deal 15% more damage for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: While the Iron's Hot
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. For 4 seconds after using it, you move 15% faster.

fusions.name: Measure Twice
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
